items.text: This table is loaded by a confirmed, fully working daily process. Each day, only records changed since the last update are pulled from the source system, matched to store and department information, and applied here. This works the same way as the already-reviewed sibling table, LOC_CATGY_PRICING_STRAT_XREF.
The staging area for this table currently holds no rows. This is expected: it means no new source changes have come in since the last real run, not a sign the process has stopped working.
No data quality issues found: every key is valid and there are no duplicate records.

The location and department combination alone is already unique across every row today, so no location/department pair currently carries more than one pricing strategy. Same pattern already found on LOC_CATGY_PRICING_STRAT_XREF.
The status code field is fully populated for every row, with three distinct values in use, unlike most other tables in this project.
